title: Split platform core contracts, build config, recording sink, and validation helpers
description: The Rust platform core facade now mixes platform type constants, adapter traits, build config, event-sender build context, recording sinks, conversation-history test storage, and platform ID validation in one file. AstrBot keeps platform metadata, message/session models, adapter base classes, register/manager code, and platform sources separated. Split this Rust core boundary before richer WeChat/QQ/Lark/Kook-style adapters add more metadata, sink, validation, and outbound behavior.

files.change: Keep current public exports stable while moving platform contracts into focused submodules.
Move PlatformAdapter and MessageRecorder traits out of the mixed core file.
Group platform type constants and PlatformConfig constructors without mixing sink or validation code.
Keep event sender/build-time dependencies separate from runtime manager state.

files.target: recording sink and sent message DTOs
files.change: Move RecordingSink, SentMessage, StreamedMessage, and test-history adapter behavior into a focused module.
Isolate platform ID validation so future platform identity and binding rules can grow outside adapter traits.

criteria: Existing astrbot_platform crate-root exports remain compatible.
Registry and manager imports do not need to know recording sink internals.
RecordingSink remains usable by tests and WebChat/mock platform paths without adding storage coupling to adapter contracts.
Platform ID validation is independently testable.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-platform && cargo clippy -p astrbot-platform -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
